snippet.title: Solid Boat Adventure - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222500/Solid_Boat_Adventure/

Teamwork is everything and surviving the dangers of each delivery mission while keeping your boat from sinking is not as easy as it might sound! Prepare for adventure!
